popCulture.title: Orpheus
popCulture.description: The singer among the Argonauts — his lyre outsinging the Sirens on the voyage to Colchis.

popCulture.title: Argonautica
popCulture.creator: Apollonius of Rhodes
popCulture.description: Apollonius keeps Orpheus in the crew — music as the ship's defense when the Sirens call.
